overview: This single-page file index concerns a 1943 request by the War Information Office for clarification of the government’s prewar policy toward the Kwantung Leased Territory. It records related correspondence and notes that a copy of Mr. Hancock’s letter of January 5, 1943, was enclosed, but the underlying letter and enclosure are not present in the surviving OCR text.

people.name: Mr. Hancock
people.role: Author of a referenced letter dated January 5, 1943

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning prewar policy toward the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.about: The index records a request for clarification of government policy toward the Kwantung Leased Territory and a related enclosure.
subfiles.summary: This filing index identifies correspondence dated February 9, 1943, concerning the government’s prewar policy toward the Kwantung Leased Territory. The War Information Office requested clarification of that policy. A filing note states that a copy of Mr. Hancock’s letter of January 5, 1943, was enclosed.

interest: The page is useful chiefly as archival evidence of correspondence that may no longer be present in this file. It shows that wartime officials sought an authoritative account of prewar policy toward the strategically important Kwantung Leased Territory and points researchers to a January 1943 letter by Mr. Hancock that may survive elsewhere.
